items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: We had them did recently at Peter Clever's church.

ctx.x: Do you remember as far back when they used to use the quadrilles?

I remember the quadrilles. I remember the cakewalk. But I was too young I didn't do those dances. No I didn't even try. I was too young for those dances. We had them did recently at Peter Clever's church. They got quite a few of the old timers that still left that can do the cakewalk and the quadrilles. And they are very good.
I knew they had some quadrilles dancers at one of the Creole festivals.
